name: reBounce Vita
author: myname24
description: Native PS Vita port of Bounce Evolution (Rovio, Nokia N900, 2009). The original ARM32 N900 binary is rebased and statically linked into the Vita eboot; libc, GL, X11, EGL, PulseAudio and dbus calls are replaced by shims. 60 fps, audio, accelerometer-style tilt.
